name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: A top bar with brand, links and an actions slot; links move into a drawer on small screens.
a11y: A header (banner landmark) with the links in their own navigation landmark named by linksLabel; the current page has aria-current="page".
Below 800px a Menu button opens the links in a drawer: focus is trapped, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.
Put it first in the page, before main, so a skip link can jump past it.

props.name: brand
props.description: Your logo or name, at the start of the bar.

props.name: links
props.description: Primary links, shown in the bar from 800px and in a drawer opened by a menu button below that. Leave out when the bar only holds actions.

props.name: linksLabel
props.description: Names the links' navigation landmark. Default "Main".

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders each link, so a client router can handle the click. Default a plain `<a href>`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Goes before the brand: put a `SidebarTrigger` here when the bar sits above a `Sidebar`.

props.name: actions
props.description: The end of the bar: search, a command palette button, an account menu.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Text of the button that opens the links drawer on small screens. Default "Menu".

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keeps the bar at the top while the page scrolls. Default false. `AppShell` already does this for its navbar.
